[[File:MillenniumFalcon1-SWE.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' was a tramp freighter]]
A '''tramp freighter''' was a type of independent [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] with no established scheduled ports of call, as opposed to a freight liner. Notable tramp freighters were the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the ''[[Pulsar Skate]]'' and ''[[Beggar's Solace]]''.
